title: strncmpi
summary: Compare text inputs case-insensitively up to N leading characters.

gpu_support.notes: Comparison is host-only. Integer `N` is parsed exactly; unsupported numeric text operands return false before provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `strncmpi(A, B, N)` compares up to `N` leading characters while ignoring letter case. `A` and `B` are text containers; `N` may be double, single, or any of the eight integer classes.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Number of leading characters to compare.

behaviors: String arrays, character arrays, and cell arrays of character vectors follow the same scalar expansion and result-shape rules as `strncmp`.
`N` accepts all eight integer classes directly from native storage. Zero and negative values compare zero characters and therefore return true.
Integer or other numeric values in `A` or `B` are unsupported text datatypes and return scalar logical false without provider access.
